origin.description: A grid of unique values, with other predictors set to a typical value.

arguments.name: data
arguments.text: Data frame whose columns are expanded.
Columns to cross, or values assigned to a name.

arguments.name: .model
arguments.text: Fitted model. Predictors that were not named are filled with typical().

origin.details: Unique values are crossed with the first column changing slowest. A column that is not named, and is not a predictor of the model, is left out.
origin.value: A data frame with one row per combination.
origin.example:
g <- data_grid(mtcars, vs, am)
cat(paste(g$vs, g$am, sep = ","), "\n")
